text: On November 4, 2015, a Zoning By-law Amendment application was submitted for the site at 71-73 Redpath Avenue, 174-200 Soudan Avenue and 18 Brownlow Avenue. The application proposed two residential towers of 25 and 20 storeys and proposed to retain the existing 19-storey tower currently on the site. On June 20, 2016, the applicant appealed the Zoning By-law Amendment Application to the Ontario Municipal Board due to Council's failure to make a decision. The Applicant has revised its proposal several times, reducing the number of residential towers from two to one, and reducing the size of the site which is subject to the application to only 174-188 Soudan Avenue and 71-73 Redpath Avenue.
